assumptions: 6A: single swinging arm per wheel; 6B: fixed-carrier coupled legs. 8A: shared front/rear carrier pitch; 8B: independent front pitch. Suspension motor torques zero; identical neutral control for added 8-DOF carrier axes. Same total mass, nominal height and angular spring settings. Preloads resolved per architecture then fixed for all its runs. Arm length/layout and mass distribution are provisional; no active levelling or hardware mass comparison.
acceptance: <5% heave/acceleration/pitch/settling changes, <0.05 deg symmetric roll or <5% asymmetric roll, <10% peak loads and <5 ms contact-loss changes. No bottoming, tip, stall, warnings, hip saturation or incomplete settling. Contact differences below 5 ms cannot select a winner.
plotting_note: After integration, history plotting was restricted to the visible time window for appropriate y-axis scaling. Integration and comparison provenance are preserved.
